resource.name: SeniorCitizenHealthScreeningPlan
resource.title: Senior Citizen Health Screening Plan
resource.description: Draft FHIR R4 order-set PlanDefinition based on the SIMS Hospitals Senior Citizen Health Screening Package page. The package is described for people over 65 years and includes laboratory tests, imaging, diagnostic procedures, and consultations. The source lists Pap Smear (Women) / PSA (Men), and lists both Vitamin D and Vitamin D3; confirm alternative/duplicate semantics with the hospital. This bundle is not a clinically validated protocol.
